reference: Original composition inspired by Tahow floating island, command palette, rounded clear glass and blue optical highlights; no reference image supplied to this generation
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original fixed wallpaper for Tahow, a modular desktop shell with a floating island, command palette and clear refractive liquid-glass surfaces.
Primary request: create a distinctive original Tahow wallpaper with beautiful liquid-glass optical material, NOT the diagonal blue folded composition from the earlier reference. Wide 16:9 desktop background. An extreme macro sculptural composition of two broad continuous transparent glass ribbons flowing horizontally in a loose open orbit. The upper ribbon curves into a softly squared capsule, inspired by a floating desktop island, while the lower ribbon opens into a broad rounded rectangular contour inspired by a command palette. They are fluid architectural contours, not actual UI panels, not a stack of cards, not individual bubbles. Crop their outer ends beyond the frame. Keep the middle third relatively quiet and open so cursive welcome lettering can later be overlaid. A large milky translucent glass arch curves in from the left and a smaller icy-clear curved ribbon sweeps toward the lower right, with depth and gentle asymmetry. Rich cobalt and glacier-blue light gathers inside the thick rounded glass edges, subtle cyan spectral fringes and fine pearly highlights, soft silver and icy-white gradients, deep ink-blue recessed shadows. Material should be convincingly thick transparent glass with refraction and soft caustic light, never opaque plastic or chrome. Background is a luminous blue-gray to pale ice gradient with a deeper blue lower-right, no objects or scenery. Refined restrained atmospheric 3D render, elegant generous negative space, extremely smooth gradients.
Constraints: create an original brand composition; no straight diagonal slash, no Apple wallpaper recreation, no OS logos, no text, no letters, no watermark, no UI, no decorative particles, no purple or pink neon. Landscape 16:9, preferably 3840x2160.
